content:
From May 11th to 15 2026, there will be a workshop at ICERM (in Providence, near Boston USA) about formalization of analysis: https://icerm.brown.edu/program/topical_workshop/tw-26-ttfa. If you want to participate, you should apply at https://icerm.brown.edu/program/topical_workshop/tw-26-ttfa#section-4 before January 14th.

We are sorry for the late announcement on this channel, we thought we did that already but the worrying number of applications revealed we forgot.
A message was moved from this topic to #general > Discussion: Formalization of Analysis at ICERM by Floris van Doorn.

The application deadline for the formalization of analysis workshop at ICERM has been extended to January 24th. Please apply if you are interested in analysis and know some Lean (this is not a school where we will teach basics of Lean)!
Does this imply that people who have already applied will be notified about their acceptance only at the end of January?
Sorry, I copy pasted from an email with a typo: it was meant to be January 24th.
